Gulf Coast's First Gig Car Rental

Gulf Coast Gig Rentals LLC is now open and accepting drivers. If you want to earn on Uber, DoorDash, Spark or any gig platform but don't have a qualifying vehicle — we have you covered. Weekly rental, fully insured, no credit check, start driving fast.

🚗

Modern, Reliable Vehicles

Late-model cars that meet all Uber, Lyft and delivery platform requirements. Clean, maintained and ready to earn from day one.

📅

One simple weekly fee. No hidden charges, no mileage fees, no surprises. A full-time driver earns $800–$960/week — your rental pays for itself fast.

Fully Insured & Maintained

Commercial fleet insurance covers the vehicle. We handle maintenance so you stay focused on earning.

⚡

Quick Approval Process

Simple application, background check and MVR review. Most drivers approved within 48 hours and behind the wheel within the week.

Built for the Gulf Coast

Biloxi's casino and tourism economy means steady 24/7 ride demand year-round. More trips, more earnings, less downtime.

Multiple Platforms

🏥 Extra Earning Opportunity — NEMT Trips

Gulf Coast Gig Rentals LLC holds active contracts with ProCare, Medicaid, and Workers' Compensation transportation programs. Qualified drivers in our fleet can be dispatched on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT) trips during off-peak hours — giving you a second income stream on top of your gig earnings.

NEMT trips pay $18–$35 each. During slow gig hours, our dispatchers route medical transport trips directly to you. No competitor in Biloxi offers this.
